sections.heading: Pricing caveats
sections.body: Verified 2026-08-17 from livestorm.co/pricing/. Pro: €2.50 per attendee credit (yearly credit packs; 1 credit per unique participant per session for live/replay/on-demand; team members not counted; no-shows not charged). Pro highlights: up to 4 hours/session, unlimited events/recording/team members, up to 3,000 live attendees/event, standard multilingual support. Enterprise: custom (up to 12 hours/session, enterprise integrations, custom analytics, dedicated CS, VIP support/SLA). Free trial CTA on pricing. Add-ons include AI Studio, live translations, SSO, restreaming, etc. Do not invent USD monthly starting prices — model is usage/credit-based in EUR.
